thread:
liam: Heads-up — CloudMart is confirmed for a marketplace promo on 2026-05-10. They estimate steady demand with a couple of hourly spikes during the 48h launch window. Need capacity plan and cost impact by EOD tomorrow.

tom: Got it. Do we have concrete numbers from CloudMart (tokens/day, QPS)?

liam: From their SOW: baseline ~1.2M tokens/day, peak bursts up to 4M tokens/day for a few hours, expected 200k embeddings/day. They want EU+US availability (eu-west-1, us-west-2). Reseller will route traffic via our hosted API.

maria: Quick instinct: bursts like that will push up concurrency and KV cache miss rates. We'll need more GPU-hours during promo and probably a higher reserved capacity for canary. Rough calc incoming.

maria: Pasted quick calc:
```
# rough tokens->gpu-hrs
peak_tokens_day = 4_000_000
tokens_per_gpu_hour = 5_000_000  # depends on model/seq len, optimistic
gpu_hours_daily_peak = ceil(peak_tokens_day / tokens_per_gpu_hour)  # ~1
# but concurrency/latency SLO means we need multiple GPUs at once for throughput
expected_concurrent_gpus_during_burst = 6  # estimate for latency headroom
```

tom: That optimistic tokens_per_gpu_hour assumes 8k context and aggressive batching. For safety use 2.5M tokens/gpu-hour -> gpu_hours_daily_peak ~= 2 -> concurrent need higher. Also region split matters: 60% US, 40% EU.

anita: We need a cost estimate for the commercial team. Use reserved vs on-demand blended pricing. Also account for Marketplace revenue share — CloudMart's promo has a revenue credit for first month.

liam: Action items: 1) infra to provide a 72h rolling capacity plan (GPU-hours + concurrency) per region for baseline and two burst scenarios; 2) finance to give blended cost and margin for promo; 3) partnerships to confirm traffic shaping and any geo pinning. Can we get that by EOD tomorrow?

tom: I can run a quick simulation and output a table. Will assume model = rdx-13b-quant and two variants (low-latency/cheap). Will include autoscale policies and warm pools. Target: min reserved in each region + burstable on-demand.

maria: Preliminary numbers I'll include in simulation: baseline concurrency US=12, EU=8; burst concurrency US=36, EU=24; warm pool 10% of burst. Will also flag network egress for EU as potential constraint if CloudMart caches not used.

anita: If we need extra reserved for the month, we should evaluate commit vs on-demand. For quick promo support we can buy a short-term dedicated pool for 2 weeks. I'll run a quote with pricing ops.

deploy-bot: Reminder — marketplace promo slot added to infra calendar: 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-12. @tom @maria

liam: Thanks — please post the sim results and a one-line recommended plan (reserve X GPUs in us-west-2, Y in eu-west-1, plus warm pool and expected incremental cost). I'll sync with CloudMart on traffic shaping and throttles. :thumbsup:
